rationale: Braking necessity and timely braking initiation are legitimate parts of P: SG-1 concerns omitted maneuvers, FR-7 requires collision-avoidance braking, and H-1 and FR-7.1 support its temporal aspect. However, the declared scope also incorporates obstacle detection and braking-command generation. These are observation and control mechanisms supporting the required response; their presence in the requirements and architecture does not establish their operation as part of the phenomenon that T requires characterised.
determining_elements: “Whether braking is required to avoid collision” appropriately identifies the condition under which omission matters.
“Whether braking maneuver initiation occurs in time,” including required braking that is not initiated, is supported response behaviour rather than an overextension by itself.
The scope's inclusion of situations where “the system detects obstacles and generates vehicle commands for braking” extends P into supporting observation and control mechanisms.
